topic: Color pairs that set the mood of a design
title: One color sets the mood
caption:
One color can change the mood of a design. Here are three simple pairs: a background color, and a text color that reads clearly on it. Each one comes with a name and a hex code you can copy.

Save this for your next design.

Follow @_brewiq.

beats.voice: One color can change the whole mood of a design. Here are three pairs to try.
beats.lower_third: One color can change the mood.

beats.voice: Wine red with warm cream often feels elegant and calm.
beats.lower_third: Wine red and cream feel elegant.

beats.voice: Forest green with soft sand often feels fresh and natural.
beats.lower_third: Forest green and sand feel fresh.

beats.voice: Deep plum with pale blush often feels rich and gentle.
beats.lower_third: Plum and blush feel rich and gentle.

beats.voice: Pick one pair, like this blue and cream, and use one color behind and one on top.
beats.lower_third: One color behind, one color on top.
